title: Morpheus8 vs Forma: Which RF Treatment?
h1: Morpheus8 vs Forma: which radiofrequency treatment is right for you?
desc: Morpheus8 vs Forma compared: needles vs no needles, depth, downtime, results for scars and tightening, and prices at Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: Both use radiofrequency heat to tighten skin. Morpheus8 delivers it through microneedles, reaching deeper to treat scars, texture and laxity, with 2 to 4 days of redness (from AED 1,999 + VAT). Forma heats from the surface with no needles and no downtime (from AED 999 + VAT), ideal for gradual tightening and maintenance.
body:
## Which to choose

- Acne scars, large pores or stretch marks: Morpheus8
- Early laxity or a no-downtime glow: Forma
- Maintaining results between bigger treatments: Forma

## Combining them

A popular plan uses Morpheus8 for remodelling, then Forma sessions to keep skin firm. Your doctor spaces them so the skin has time to recover.
faq: Morpheus8 makes bigger changes; Forma is gentler and gradual.
Can I do Forma before an event?
Are they safe for darker skin?
Radiofrequency suits all skin tones when settings are right.
